A second governed site of this card's class, from the at-tier contract review of PR #20181 (record `5854088720`, ③) · `domain:spec` seat 2 (`session_01QcAS3qiYYZNezaxZxaUdMV`) · 2026-09-27T08:13Z

`.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md` §3 (:180–236) lists what a D2-route retirement owes, and it names no per-family D3 entry. At :234 it frames D3 as the route for keys with no rewritable source. The reviewer read this as a gap rather than the old rule stated outright. Still, a retirement author who follows the playbook ships no D3 entry for a family with a lossless D2 conversion, which is what ruling B on #17152 now requires.

It is the same ruling, the same governed lane and the same reader, so it is folded here. ⛔ Not a separate card. Whoever claims this card corrects both sites, or says why the skill should not.

Path: the road — 发布并装进一个环境 | 缺项 (no checklist item reads the retirement playbook) | P4

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `documentation` · `priority:p3` · `domain:skills` · `area:devpath` · `pm:queue`. The governed-text half of the family; #20201 carries the spec half

Triage: lands in `docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md` (the migration-chain parenthesis at about line 175, 「(the residue D2 cannot express losslessly)」) and in `.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md` §3 (`:180-236`, appended `5854114102`) ⇒ `domain:skills`, since both are governed surface (Tier H). Rationale: both still teach the D3 rule from before ruling B on #17152. A retirement author who follows either ships no D3 entry for a family with a lossless D2 conversion. That has already happened in major 18 (`tenancy.organizationField` and `cacheTtl`, now on #20201). It is an instrument card with a named consequence, and it cost no landing ⇒ **p3**.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01W89enF2dYV7K4N2Fbfj33f` · 2026-09-27T08:22Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card and its thread, #20201 and its thread, #17152 and PR #20181 (open, in flight; it references this card).

**Not folded into #20201, and not closed.** It is the same family, but the gate tier differs: every file here is governed and lands only on the maintainer's approval, while #20201's spec entries do not need to wait on that. PR #20181 (in flight) also references this card, and in-flight work is never folded. The split keeps each PR to one approver.

**Execution notes.**
1. ADR-0087: change only the line-175 parenthesis to ruling B (one D3 entry per retirement family, even when D2 is lossless; D2 carries the mechanical data repair). The line-152 sentence (D2's scope) needs no change.
2. `spec-property-retirement` §3: add the per-family D3 entry to what a D2-route retirement owes. Reframe `:234` so that D3 is not only the route for keys with no rewritable source. If the skills seat judges the skill should not say this, it says why here.
3. One Tier H PR for both files, citing `5615360777` / `5634031140`.
